purpose: Correct the asymmetric startup timer found after the first strict post-change run while preserving every v2 sample, result, and numeric gate.

lineage.interpretation: The timer asymmetry invalidates only the v2 cross-implementation startup interpretation. The v2 heap failure and all other preserved observations remain part of the audit record.

matchedProtocol.order: Odd pairs run legacy-candidate; even pairs run candidate-legacy. Each pair is adjacent in one quiet window.
matchedProtocol.failurePolicy: The attempt directory is create-only. Completed raw records and per-process stdout/stderr logs remain even when a later process fails. No unfavorable completed run is discarded or replaced.

logicalWorkload.readiness: One echo call carrying ready, with exact returned value validation.
logicalWorkload.warmup: 200 sequential echo calls carrying warmup-0 through warmup-199, with every returned value validated.
logicalWorkload.measurement: 1000 sequential echo calls carrying value-0 through value-999, with every returned value validated.
logicalWorkload.wireDisclosure: The logical payload sequence is matched. Protocol envelopes differ, so actual encoded request and response frame lengths for readiness, warmup-0, and value-0 are recorded and reported for both implementations.

startup.start: The first statement in main, before every implementation-owned event-loop, dispatch group, server, client, or connection is constructed.
startup.end: Immediately after the first successful readiness RPC response is decoded and its exact echo value is validated.

matchedProtocol.idleMemory: After readiness and all 200 validated warm-up calls, System.gc and a fixed 200 ms wait; record MemoryMXBean heap used bytes and ps RSS bytes.
matchedProtocol.latencyAndThroughput: The same 1000 validated sequential measured RPCs; per-call System.nanoTime latency and one enclosing measured-loop throughput interval.

statistics.ordering: Validate metadata and workload markers, compute fresh legacy summaries and capped margins, then read candidate metric values and compute paired differences.
statistics.memoryPass: upper95CI(candidate-minus-legacy)<0 for idle heap and idle RSS

structuralGates.dependencyMethod: Fresh dependency:copy-dependencies with includeScope=runtime. Test-scoped JUnit and Hamcrest are excluded.
structuralGates.claimBoundary: The core-only comparison is not presented as a reduction of the complete distribution.

executableEvidence.identityVerification: benchmarks/v3/verify-identities.mjs verifies source, POM, runtime JAR, compiled-class tree, harness, structure, and coordinator hashes

publicationGate: No low-footprint, startup, latency, or memory improvement claim is permitted until an independent reviewer approves v3.1 and every runtime and structural gate passes on the frozen candidate identity.
